text: Integer tokens shall be optional adjacent `-` followed by canonical decimal digits or lowercase `0x` and one or more hexadecimal digits. Negative zero and either case of hex digits shall be accepted. Leading `+`, decimal leading zeros, separated minus, suffixes, digit separators, binary/octal/floating notation shall be rejected.
